queued_rollback.description: Cancel a queued (pending) run with action=rollback before it starts
queued_rollback.note: Documented contract says rollback DELETES the run; installed 0.12.6 does NOT delete a never-started queued run — it survives as interrupted (verified 2026-08-19, user-approved deviation in langgraph_smoke.py:237-247). OSS must match the OBSERVED behavior (keep with interrupted), not the docs.

running_rollback.description: Cancel a running run with rollback
running_rollback.checkpoint: pre-run snapshot restored via aupdate_state; if no prior state then checkpointer thread deleted
running_rollback.note: todo 4 implements aupdate_state restore + thread deletion for empty history; todo 8 must re-verify checkpoint history semantics whether new checkpoint vs rewind

after_rollback.description: Thread accepts a fresh run after rollback (langgraph_smoke.py:251-258)

accepted_deviation: Keeping interrupted instead of deleting queued run is an ACCEPTED deviation matching langgraph_smoke.py:237-247 precedent — the installed oracle itself diverges from docs. OSS mirrors the oracle observation. Re-assert deletion after server upgrade if upstream changes.
assertions_for_oss: Queued run cancelled with rollback → status interrupted, record still GET-able
Running run cancelled with rollback → status interrupted, checkpoint restored
Thread accepts new runs after rollback
